name: Leilani Alnair
japaneseName: レイラニ・アルナイル
description: Leilani Alnair was a Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult representing Gluttony and the mother of Lye Batenkaitos, Roy Alphard, and Rui Arneb. Introduced in the side story Re:Zero EX: Scorpion Tales, she formerly wielded the Authority of Gluttony.
